title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979 No 47

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979 No 47
sections.section: RGLN. - Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979, No. 47
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th September 1979]
No. 47
1. Notwithstanding anything
contained in Martial Law Regulation No. 33 as amended from time to tine :‑‑
(a) A Martial Law Administrator
by promulgation of a Martial Law Order, may, for the purposes of elections to
the Local Government institutions allow such activity within the Zone as he
deems expedient.
(b) A Martial Law Order
promulgated by a Martial Law Administrator under clause (a) shall cease to have
effect 48 hours before the commencement of poll for elections to the Local
Government institutions,
(c) Any contravention of the
provision of a Martial Law Order Pro mulgated under clause (a) shall be
punished as contravention of Martial Law Regulation No. 33 as amended from time
to time.
sections.punishment:
shall be
